grid_strategy.marketing: Asymmetrical 'Bento' grid with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave negative space for emotional breathing room.
grid_strategy.dashboard: Tight functional grid (gap-6). Use h-full for equal heights.

motion_and_interaction.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists and feed items (framer-motion recommended).

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans', or 'Lato' for headings. Use 'Clash Display' for bold advocacy impact. Use 'Manrope' for body text.
Use solid HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections, allowing for asymmetry and overlapping elements. Avoid rigid Shadcn Card components in the hero or unique story sections.
Use Shadcn UI components ONLY for complex interactive logic like the booking form, directory filters, and contact forms.
Hero image MUST use a gradient overlay for text readability, e.g., 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1F1A17]/80 to-transparent'. Never use a flat black 50% overlay.
Never use pure black or pure white shadows; tint shadows with the primary background color to maintain warmth.
Emphasize negative space. Use 'p-8' or 'p-12' inside containers to give the heavy emotional content breathing room.
The AI Chatbot should feel like a safe, grounded tool—use soft borders, ample padding, and the warm secondary color (#5A7059) for its header/UI accents.
In the Mission/About section, emphasize the 'advocacy-driven' tone by using large typography for key statements, paired with the deep terracotta accent color.
